decision.observation: The goose holds the boot just south of the closed back gate; the latch pipe fittings on the right post only sparkle. No NPC has appeared despite several short-wait honks.
decision.hypothesis: The groundskeeper beyond the gate opens it in response to honking but needs several seconds to walk over; a honk followed by a long (~10s) wait has never been tested.
decision.memory: Honk animation is confirmed. Long post-honk wait is the main untested variable for this gate.
